title: Faith-based homelessness recommendations and strategic plan
summary: On November 21, a commission working group presented recommendations on how the County can better address homelessness and involve faith-based groups, and the commission plans to vote on each one at a later meeting. The recommendations include asking the mayor to have all County departments include the commission in homelessness work, and seeking grant funding for district-by-district data on unsheltered people. The director asked that the homeless strategic plan go on the January agenda.
